CoArrange Hum-to-Music uses these third-party projects. The page does not copy their websites.

Spotify Basic Pitch, TypeScript library @spotify/basic-pitch 1.0.1
https://github.com/spotify/basic-pitch-ts
Copyright 2022 Spotify AB
Apache License 2.0. The license text is in web/third-party/basic-pitch-LICENSE.
The model weights are downloaded into web/vendor/model and are not committed. Run npm run pitch-model.
Research: Bittner et al., "A Lightweight Instrument-Agnostic Model for Polyphonic
Note Transcription and Multipitch Estimation", ICASSP 2022.
https://arxiv.org/abs/2203.09893

TensorFlow.js @tensorflow/tfjs 4.22.0
https://github.com/tensorflow/tfjs
Apache License 2.0. It runs the Basic Pitch graph in the browser.
The license text is in web/third-party/tfjs-LICENSE.

Reviewed and not embedded as an application:

htmlapps-audio-to-midi
https://github.com/ttomohisa/htmlapps-audio-to-midi
Copyright (c) 2026 ttomohisa, MIT License.
It is a complete single-page app around the same Basic Pitch model. CoArrange
calls the official library instead of copying that website.

Symphony
https://github.com/ericswork/symphony
A separate browser demo for chord suggestions. The repository has no license
file, and its pitch tracker is Pitchy rather than Basic Pitch. It is not
included in this project.
